person.persName: الدماميني, محمد بن ابي بكر بن عمر
al-Damāmīnī, Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr b. ʻUmar
محمد بن ابي بكر بن عمر بن ابي بكر بن محمد بن سليمان بن جعفر المخزومي الاسكندري المالكي الدمامني بدر الدين
Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr b. ʻUmar b. Abī Bakr b. Muḥammad b. Sulaymān b. Ǧaʻfar al-Maḫzūmī al-Iskandarī al-Mālikī al-Damāmīnī Badr al-Dīn
person.floruit: 9th / 15th century (763/1362-827/1424)Mālikī scholar, born in Iskandariyya, studied with Ibn Ḫaldūn in Cairo. He lived for a while in Damascus but returned soon to Egypt, where he acted as qāḍī. Later he traveled to Yemen and was teaching in Zabīd for about a year and then settled in India. He died in India in the city of Gulbarga.
